dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: extranodal involvement of the right kidney (3.2 cm), left adrenal gland (2.6 cm) and liver segment VI (1.8 cm)

stage_b_symptoms.quote: with B symptoms (drenching night sweats, 8 kg/10% weight loss)

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: not double-hit/triple-hit and not a double-expressor by IHC

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5 of 5 (age >60, stage IV, LDH > ULN, >1 extranodal site, ECOG 2)

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI 6 of 6 (age >60, stage IV, ECOG 2, elevated LDH, >1 extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement)

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: every 21 days for 6 cycles, with full-dose doxorubicin (baseline LVEF 60%)

tx_pola_preferred.quote: if polatuzumab is not available or approved, R-CHOP x6 is the appropriate equivalent

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R or a reduced-intensity/frailty regimen

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R or a reduced-intensity/frailty regimen

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High: CNS-IPI 6 of 6 (age >60, stage IV, ECOG 2, elevated LDH, >1 extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement)

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will obtain baseline CSF cytology and flow cytometry (and MRI brain only if symptoms develop).
cns_staging_mri_csf.note: CSF cytology/flow ordered but baseline brain MRI deferred unless symptomatic.

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: if renal function recovers to normal, high-dose systemic methotrexate would be the preferred prophylaxis
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Ties HD-MTX to renal recovery and notes weak evidence, but commits to IT MTX rather than leaving prophylaxis individualized.

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: because high-dose intravenous methotrexate is not safe with eGFR 50

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Assess response with PET-CT using Lugano 2014/Deauville criteria about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: If Deauville 4-5, biopsy the residual site

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: admit or closely observe with vigorous IV hydration and frequent potassium, phosphorus, calcium, uric acid and creatinine monitoring
sup_tls_prophylaxis.note: High-risk TLS plan with hydration and rasburicase, but lab frequency not specified as every 6-12 h.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg after confirming G6PD status

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen now: it is contributing to the AKI and is unsafe with this renal/TLS risk

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: monitor glucose closely because steroids will worsen his diabetes; hold metformin if renal function worsens

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs reactive, so no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: his ECOG 2 is largely disease-related, so he should be treated with curative intent
